input_text:
Synthetic example, not real intelligence. Threat intelligence reports indicate that the intrusion operator conducted credential harvesting against the target host. Endpoint telemetry recorded the following command invocation:
procdump.exe -ma lsass.exe lsass.dmp
The operator utilized Sysinternals Procdump to dump the memory of the Local Security Authority Subsystem Service to extract cached credentials.
gate_reason: Too narrow: caught extracted line but missed hidden variant
rule_yaml:
title: ProcDump Used To Dump LSASS Memory
status: test
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\procdump.exe'
        CommandLine|contains|windash|all:
            - '-ma'
            - 'lsass.exe'
    condition: selection
level: high
tags:
    - attack.credential-access
    - attack.t1003.001
